summary.note: Baseline dispatched to a fresh general-purpose agent with no knowledge of identifying-feature-opportunities' SKILL.md or its scoring/disposition conventions, and an explicit exclusion instruction barring it from reading anything under plugins/analysis-kit/skills/identifying-feature-opportunities/ or evals/ (a first attempt without this exclusion had read the skill's own opportunity-rubric.md and this eval's own with_skill/grading.json 'answer key' and was discarded as contaminated). The retained baseline independently investigated mining-recurring-patterns' own SKILL.md and scripts and reached the same substantive conclusion (worth building, no existing overlap) but lacks the skill's own structured disposition label and four-band scoring discipline -- the two failing assertions are exactly the skill's own procedural contribution, not evidence the underlying judgment was wrong.
